description: Reliability analysis for up to 25 recurring tasks, jobs, pipelines or scheduled workflows in one call. Returns a reliability score and grade (healthy/degrading/unstable/failing) per task, lapse risk, streak recovery, latency-trend warnings, and remediation actions ranked by priority so the list is actionable top-down. Use for cron and pipeline monitoring, flaky-job triage, SLA and uptime adherence, agent task reliability, and deciding what to fix first. Deterministic threshold analysis over the figures you supply — no model, no log parsing, no root-cause inference. Costs $0.08 in USDC on Base.

system.description: Optional label to correlate the response with a system.

tasks.description: Price is per CALL, not per task — sending 25 costs the same as sending one.

critical.description: Optional. True when a failure blocks downstream work. Raises priority.

latency_trend.description: Optional. Direction of p95 latency. Rising is the degradation signal.

name.description: Task, job, pipeline or workflow name.

risk_score.description: Optional. Your own prior; blended, never overriding.

runs.description: Optional. Total runs; under 10 marks the assessment provisional.

name: analyze_reliability
